about: Mutants of compiler/check/infer, type-argument inference as a frame by parameter position (capstone S3d1). The infer laws (TestCompilerInferLawsRun) or the seeded property against the Go checker (TestCompilerInferProperty) kill each.

mutants.name: frame-not-cut
mutants.rule: An inference's end cuts the stack to its mark.

mutants.name: slot-ignores-base
mutants.rule: A callee's parameters are the pool's positions past the caller's own; the caller's parameters are never the call's.

mutants.name: shape-unchecked
mutants.rule: A slice, map, pointer, array or tuple matches only its own kind.

mutants.name: bound-unchecked
mutants.from: return nify(s, f, u, c, b, y, mode, d)
mutants.rule: A bound parameter's binding must match the next argument.

mutants.name: unbound-accepted
mutants.rule: A type parameter no argument binds is not inferred.

mutants.name: row-extra-dropped
mutants.from: Bind(f, c, k, if k == firstFree { store.TRow(s, extra) } else { empty })
mutants.rule: A free row parameter binds to what the argument's row adds.

mutants.name: row-not-widened
mutants.from: Bind(f, c, firstJoined, store.TRow(s, union(*s, store.OperandsOf(*s, b), extra)))
mutants.to: Bind(f, c, firstJoined, store.TRow(s, union(*s, store.OperandsOf(*s, b)[0:0], extra)))
mutants.rule: A joined row parameter widens to the union of every argument's row.

mutants.name: no-value-unbound
mutants.rule: A result parameter matched against no result binds to no value.

mutants.name: literal-default-int
mutants.rule: A parameter only literals bind takes their default type.

mutants.name: written-ignored
mutants.to: Bind(f, c, i, if dense.Index(t) < 0 { t } else { store.TBasic(s, 3) })
mutants.rule: A written type argument is the binding.

mutants.rule: A parameter bound to a variant takes the union a later argument names (unify.go unionOf, G-exup-2).

mutants.name: elements-not-exact
mutants.from: func elemMode(mode int) int { if mode&assign != 0 { mode | exact } else { mode } }
mutants.rule: A slice's element matches exactly under assign (unify.go emode): a variant bound first refuses a later []U.

mutants.name: generic-variants-unsubstituted
mutants.rule: A generic union's instance has its variant templates at its arguments (under(Option[int]) is Some[int] | None).
